title: Baagupadu User Profile Schema
description: Complete schema for storing all user data, including profile, life stages, patterns, traits, persona, and conversation memory.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created

last_accessed.description: Timestamp when the user last interacted with Sahayam

user_info.description: Basic user information provided during the journey

session_progress.description: Current progress of the user through the 6-phase journey

current_phase.description: Current phase the user is in (matches frontend store exactly)

phase_completed.description: List of phases the user has completed

last_exchange_id.description: ID of the last exchange in the conversation

total_exchanges.description: Total number of exchanges in the conversation

life_stage_data.description: All data collected from each life stage

childhood.description: Data from the childhood exploration phase

responses.description: List of user responses in the childhood phase

examples: I loved building things with Legos

teenage.description: Data from the teenage exploration phase

responses.description: List of user responses in the teenage phase

examples: I felt like no one understood me

adult.description: Data from the adult exploration phase

responses.description: List of user responses in the adult phase

examples: I want to make a difference in the world

phase_summaries.description: Compressed summaries of each completed phase (for token efficiency)

examples: User was initially hesitant but opened up about career confusion
User was a curious child who loved building things and asking 'why'. They felt different from other kids and often preferred being alone.
User struggled with feeling unseen in high school but developed resilience through art and found a close friend who understood them.
User is purpose-driven, wants to make an impact, and values autonomy in their career.
Persona built: The Curious Explorer. Key strengths: Natural pattern recognition, intellectual versatility, self-awareness.
Career roadmap delivered: Product Designer with UX Research and Product Management alternatives. Skill gaps: Figma, User Research, Prototyping.

inferences.description: All inferences drawn from the user's data (from inference_engine.md)

shadow_traits.description: Identified shadow traits with tentative confidence

examples: "I always wanted to make everyone happy"

pattern_disruptions.description: Pattern disruptions where the user evolved

examples: Learned self-protection after being taken advantage of

contradictions.description: Contradictions in user data that need attention

examples: User values both freedom and stability
Noted as a tension to explore

holding_pen.description: Patterns with only 1 piece of evidence (waiting for confirmation)

examples: Always learning, always questioning, always seeking.
A deep desire to create things that matter
A need for autonomy and intellectual freedom

blocked_topics.description: Topics the user has asked to forget

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the user's journey
